title: Ford 8.8 Explorer Rear Axle Wilwood Forged Dynalite Rear Parking Brake Kit
description:
Upgrade or convert your rear drum brakes to a high-performance disc setup with the Wilwood Forged Dynalite Rear Parking Brake Kit (140-16407-D). Engineered specifically for custom builds, muscle cars, and street/strip vehicles running a Ford 8.8" Explorer rear axle housing (2.54" axle offset), this kit combines serious stopping power with a fully functional internal parking brake assembly.

Featuring 4-piston Dynalite calipers, 12.19" x 0.81" drilled and slotted SRP rotors, and an internal drum-in-hat parking brake shoe design, this setup provides a clean, hidden emergency brake setup without ugly external mechanical levers hanging off the caliper.

#### What’s Included:

* Forged Dynalite 4-Piston Calipers: Finished in durable black powder coat with stainless steel pistons.
* 12.19" x 0.81" SRP Rotors: Vented, cross-drilled, and slotted iron rotors with a black e-coat finish to inhibit rust on non-friction surfaces.
* Internal Drum-in-Hat Parking Brake Mechanism: Tightly integrated shoe system housed inside the rotor hat for exceptional holding power and a clean look.
* BP-10 Smart Pads & Hardware: Street-performance friction pads, axle mounting brackets, and grade-8 installation hardware.

#### Key Specs & Notes:

* Axle Fitment: Fits Ford 8.8" Explorer rear axle flanges with a 2.54" axle offset (commonly swapped into Fox Bodies, classic Fords, and custom builds).
* Wheel Stud Clearance: Rotor hats are pre-drilled for 1/2" diameter wheel studs (dual 5x4.5" & 5x4.75" bolt patterns).
* Wheel Clearance: Fits most popular 15" and larger rear wheels (verify clearance profile prior to mounting).
* Brake Lines & Parking Cables Required: Flexlines and parking brake cables are not included with this core kit. Requires stainless flexlines (Wilwood P/N 220-0627 or similar) and custom parking brake cables (such as Wilwood P/N 330-9371).

#### Vehicle / Axle Application:

* Vehicles equipped with a Ford 8.8-Inch Rear Axle utilizing factory Ford Explorer end flanges and a 2.54" axle offset.
